tools.name: get_scan_summary
tools.description: The latest completed scan of one AWS account or repository: when it ran, grades with the reason a grade is capped, findings by severity and pillar, potential monthly savings, and what changed since the scan before it (new findings, resolved ones and the monthly cost they saved).

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "list_targets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
